values.note: Polk County campground fees in effect from Jan. 1, 2025: water and electric site $20 a night ('subject to change'); primitive tent camping $10. Dumping free for registered campers. Cash or check only.

fees.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ ('The following rule revisions will be in effect beginning Jan. 1, 2025.' 'Water and electric : $20 per day', 'Primitive camping: $10 per day', '*Fees are per night and are subject to change.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/lake-arbuckle-park/ ('Each of the location's 38 campsites has water and electric hookups for RVs'; Amenities: 'Partial Hookups 50 Amp, 30 Amp and 20 Amp Water'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The county's page says 'Each of the location's 38 campsites has water and electric hookups' and, in its amenity list, '39 RV Sites' and '6 primitive sites' (tent only, no RVs).

sites.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/lake-arbuckle-park/ (description and amenity list) + https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ ('Primitive camping is tent camping only, with no water or electric. No RVs.'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/lake-arbuckle-park/ ('the campground has bathhouse with restrooms and showers'; Facilities: 'Dump station', 'Restrooms: flush', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'No reservations until more reliable internet becomes available. Campgrounds will remain first-come, first-served until a new online booking system becomes available.' Cash or check only. After a stay of 8 or more days a camper must leave the campground for 28 days; 100 days a year across all Polk County campgrounds. Check-out noon; after-hours entry must be pre-arranged with the resident caretaker.

booking.source: https://www.polkfl.gov/things-to-do/parks-and-recreation/campgrounds/2025-campground-rules/ (Rules and Regulations; 'maximum length of stay per visit – 14 consecutive days'; 'Set a cumulative maximum stay in Polk County facilities of 100 days per year.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Polk County park on Lake Arbuckle near Frostproof, with a separate primitive tent area and a boat ramp (open 6 a.m.-10 p.m.); sites each with table, fire ring, grill. Sites large, shaded by cypress/live oak; one report documents a 28-ft RV. --Claude
summary: Polk County pages: confirmed FCFS-only (no reservations), 14-night max, water hookups, showers/dump; added $20 water+electric fee (2025 rules), 50-amp electric, flush toilets, the 8-days-then-28-away and 100-days-a-year limits, cash/check only. Site count conflicts on the county page (38 vs 39 RV sites), both noted. Note cleaned (dropped hookups/facilities/booking/rating restatements). Not stated: season, rig length.
